freezeRule: Frozen before c05 starts (plan c03). Any change to a threshold, the default, the rubric or the matrix after freeze needs a design-lead adjudication record in `adjudications` AND an operator-adopted contract amendment if it loosens acceptance. Never loosen a threshold to turn a failing value scenario green.

comparison.engine: Playwright expect(...).toHaveScreenshot against tests/fidelity/baselines/<theme>/<viewport>/<state-id with dots as hyphens>.png
comparison.captureEnvironment: tests/fidelity/src/support/capture-environment.ts (frozen clock 2026-11-10T15:00:00Z, UTC, en-US, DPR 1, animations disabled, caret hidden, self-hosted fonts); recorded in baselines/manifest.json
comparison.updateSnapshots: none (the boundary run must never write or refresh a baseline)
comparison.sizeMismatch: A different image size is a failure (Playwright default), never auto-cropped.

verdictRule.atOrBelowThreshold: PASS, unless design-lead logged a fidelity defect for that cell in `adjudications` before the boundary run started, in which case FAIL
verdictRule.missingBaseline: BLOCKED (a missing baseline is never captured on the fly)
verdictRule.missingAppRoute: BLOCKED (no entry in oracle/app-state-map.json for the state)
verdictRule.unresolvedDifference: Any FAIL or BLOCKED cell blocks the c13 boundary (plan c13).

reference.rule: Reference captures (brand guide logo, clear space, type; live room layout skeleton) are reviewed side by side with the app's rendering of the same element; they never pass or fail by pixel ratio.

exceptionRubric.when: Before the c13 boundary run starts. Requests raised during or after the run apply only to a later, separately authorised run.

allowedGrounds.description: Sub-pixel anti-aliasing differences from font rendering only, with identical glyph positions and metrics.
allowedGrounds.maxRaise: maxDiffPixelRatio up to 0.02 for that cell

allowedGrounds.description: The prototype itself is wrong against tokens.json or the brand guide (source hierarchy: tokens.json > brand guide > prototype > live prototype) and design-lead records the correct reference.
allowedGrounds.maxRaise: cell compared against a design-lead approved replacement baseline, recorded with its digest

allowedGrounds.description: Content the frozen clock cannot fix (for example a random seed) and that is not a design property.
allowedGrounds.maxRaise: mask the dynamic region only, region recorded as CSS selector and box

allowedGrounds.description: Native or browser chrome outside the page (scrollbars, focus ring default) that the design does not specify.

neverAllowed: Colour, spacing, radius, type scale or weight differences
Layout reflow or different page height
Theme-specific differences (a cell may not be excepted in one theme to hide a token bug)
exceptionRubric.record: Append to `adjudications`: {cell: state/theme/viewport, ground, change, rationale, decidedBy: design-lead, decidedAt, baselineSha256}. Each record is evidence for the boundary run.
